*Note:
\- Contains mostly BL, with two exceptions: **ViaGra Just Friend** and **Honja Seol Su Isseoyo?**, both HL (heterosexual)
\- Released concurrently on Lezhin as an anthology and Bomtoon as individual titles
\- Lezhin classifies the first chapters as prologues (프롤로그), whereas Bomtoon labels them previews (미리보기)*
